stories.title: Chair of Utah Democrats: 'We're still riding high'
stories.summary: For the first time in a very long time, Republicans will not enjoy a supermajority (two-thirds of the seats) in the Utah House.

stories.title: Whether you're team plastic or wood, here's how to sanitize your cutting board
stories.summary: The cutting board might be the hardest working tool in the kitchen yet one thought about least. It takes the raw chicken, then the onions, then sometimes the bread, and in between it typically gets a quick swipe with the nearest sponge.

stories.title: Millions of American drivers are speeding. The environment could be paying the price
stories.summary: Drivers who speed save less than a minute of travel time on average. Meanwhile, 6.7 million gallons of fuel are wasted — not to mention what speeding means for CO2 emissions

stories.title: Prosecutors abandon plan to use AI simulation of murdered woman's voice in death penalty case
stories.summary: The Weber County Attorney's Office is seeking a third death sentence against Douglas Lovell for the death of Joyce Yost.

stories.title: Heisman moments: Devon Dampier takes over as No. 2 Utah pulls away late to blowout TCU
stories.summary: Utah quarterback Devon Dampier was under duress all night.

stories.title: Instant takeaways: Devon Dampier delivers again in the 4th quarter in Utah football's win
stories.summary: When TCU tied the game with 9:26 left Saturday night, Devon Dampier had eight rushing yards.

stories.title: Cossa emerges as Utah's No. 1 goaltender as Mammoth outlast Ducks
stories.summary: As injuries continue to test the Utah Mammoth's depth, several key contributors have stepped up at a critical point in the season.

stories.title: Daybreak Winter Village offers new ways to give back
stories.summary: For Braxton and Hillary Andersen, Christmas is about more than festive lights and family gatherings. It's also an opportunity to teach their children the importance of helping others.

stories.title: Little Mercury gets its first visitor in years as a pair of spacecraft loop into orbit
stories.summary: A pair of spacecraft slipped into orbit around Mercury on Saturday after an eight-year cruise through the inner solar system to unravel our littlest planet's mountain of mysteries.

stories.title: Holy Cross Hospital hosts community party to celebrate 50 years of serving others
stories.summary: Holy Cross Hospital – Davis hosted a community celebration on Saturday, thanking the community for 50 years of support with cake, live demonstrations and giveaways.

stories.title: Immigration officers make arrests at Seattle airport in 'distressing' scene, delaying flight
stories.summary: Masked immigration officers detained two people on a crowded airport jet bridge in Seattle as people were boarding Saturday, causing what the airline called a "distressing" scene for passengers and employees and delaying the Los Angeles-bound flight.

stories.title: USU researchers highlight Great Salt Lake concerns, improving air quality in report to lawmakers
stories.summary: Utah State University researchers are urging state lawmakers to take a closer look at Utah's environmental challenges, from getting more water to the Great Salt Lake to managing the onslaught of proposals for data centers.
